title: andropogon unilateralis
intro: Andropogon unilateralis, commonly known as Black Grass or Indian Rye Grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Andropogon unilateralis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
